attach to session NAME, beside any terminal attached to it already: each shows
claude, whose window takes the size of the terminal used last. With
--detach-others, those terminals are detached.

Usage:
  cld join (-n NAME | -s SUFFIX) [--detach-others] [flags]

Flags:
      --detach-others   detach any other terminal attached to the session
  -h, --help            help for join
  -n, --name NAME       session NAME: up to 64 letters, digits, "_" and "-",
                        starting with a letter or digit
  -s, --suffix SUFFIX   session REPO-SUFFIX, REPO being the name of the git
                        repository here; SUFFIX alone outside one
